reference_hook_summary: Opening-only adaptation of a viral split-screen crying selfie hook: an ordinary young student films herself extremely close to the front phone camera at night, visibly overwhelmed and crying about an academic/productivity pain point. Preserve the emotional grammar, selfie roughness, close-up framing, and hook rhythm, but use an original fictional person and changed room, outfit, props, and gesture timing.

product.one_liner: Clearfy checks AI-likeness and helps humanize academic writing.

observation.environment: dim dorm bedroom or study corner at night, plain wall, desk just below frame, messy but realistic student setting
observation.expression: tearful, embarrassed, overwhelmed academic panic; eyes wet and puffy, brows pinched upward, red nose, lips trembling, trying not to fully sob
observation.action: starts with face very close to the selfie camera, looks down at phone or laptop, slowly lifts eyes to the camera, gives a tiny helpless head shake, swallows or sniffles, then leans even closer with a silent cry-laugh reaction
observation.atmosphere: raw Snapchat-style private meltdown, painfully relatable but slightly funny, not polished, not glamorous
observation.camera: front-facing phone camera, extreme close-up selfie, face partly cropped, subtle shaky handheld movement, low-resolution native UGC feel
observation.lighting_color: soft dim warm indoor light with phone-camera noise and natural skin shine

person.framing: vertical 9:16 smartphone selfie, extreme close-up face, forehead or chin slightly cropped, no perfect centered composition
